comments.value: I'd like to second this, but also note that this should also allow all authors to push updates to said world ID, for folks who develop in a collaborative git/svn environment.
This is something that would be needed when the "Economy" comes around. Split evenly between co-authors

This would be really nice for commission work or collaborative efforts. I could even see it going beyond that with multiple 'authors' having access to administrative tools in instances. Anywho... I'll give this one a vote, it seems like it would be a really nice addition to the game.
this is something world authors can do by putting up a board on a wall and showing who made and worked on the world
board on a wall doesn't show in world or user profile, that's the point

@{5a9fe9983955314156acc4f7|full_name} it is still possible you just have to edit it more.

also people can just look up the person as well in the user search option.

details:
As I noticed, a lot of worlds made not only by one creator, but with different kind of support of other players. So to be fair this ppl should be shown in world profile in game and on site.

So I suggest:
- to make ablity for world creators to provide user IDs (usr_???) of co-authors in scene descriptor or using API. 
- to show co-authors in world profile not just as list of nicknames, but as scrollabe  list under the instances list (may be folded by default): the uploader first and the other provided after.
- to show worlds in co-authors menu, so co-authors can go to that worlds and drop portals when it's not in public.
- to show published worlds in co-authors profiles, the same way currently published world shown in author profile.
title: More than one author of world or co-authors.
